title: Drawing insights from COVID-19-infected patients using CT scan images and machine learning techniques: a study on 200 patients
summary: The primary source Methods/Results confirm the represented result: Retrospective ML (Azure Custom Vision) classification of COVID-19 CT scans in 200 patients with about 91% accuracy; AI is the enabling classifier with a clinically specific retrospective evaluation. The source reports the defined cohort/experiment and its reference or test comparison; interpretation is restricted to that study design.
